# Youth Ka Pakistan

> Youth Ka Pakistan (YKP Foundation) is a nationwide nonprofit in Karachi helping Pakistani youth build skills, find mentors, and join free events.

Youth Ka Pakistan educates, empowers, skills, and connects young people across Pakistan. Official pages and events are listed below.

## Pages

- [Home](https://youthkapakistan.com/): Official Youth Ka Pakistan homepage
- [Events](https://youthkapakistan.com/events): URAAN-E-AI 2026, Pakistan's Digital Flight, free AI seminar in Karachi
- [Gallery](https://youthkapakistan.com/gallery): Photos from Pakistan Chef Icon Award, Marka e Haq, and other YKP events
- [Blog](https://youthkapakistan.com/blog): Stories on skills, mentorship, and youth opportunity
- [Contact](https://youthkapakistan.com/contact): Email, phone, and Karachi location

## Leadership

- [Saima Agha, MPA](https://youthkapakistan.com/): President of Youth Ka Pakistan
- [Ms. Sabi](https://youthkapakistan.com/): Chairperson of Youth Ka Pakistan YKP Foundation
- [Syed Nasir Hussain Shah](https://youthkapakistan.com/): Patron-in-Chief; YKP events are held under his supervision
- [Azhar Zia Muhammad](https://youthkapakistan.com/): Vice President of YKP Foundation, EMA Group of Companies

## Blog

- [Skills that open doors](https://youthkapakistan.com/blog/skills-that-open-doors): Why practical learning matters for Pakistani youth
- [Mentorship for Pakistani youth](https://youthkapakistan.com/blog/mentorship-for-pakistani-youth): How mentorship turns talent into a career
- [URAAN-E-AI 2026](https://youthkapakistan.com/blog/uraan-e-ai-2026-digital-flight): Pakistan's Digital Flight lands in Karachi
